entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eurico dos Santos Veloso was a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He was auxiliary bishop of Juiz de Fora from 1987 to 1991, bishop of Luz from 1994 to 2001, and archbishop of Juiz de Fora from 2001 to 2009. He died on 30 September 2023, at the age of 90.
